mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ad_slot WHERE status = 1 AND (start_at IS NULL OR start_at <= now()) AND (end_at IS NULL OR end_at >= now()) ORDER BY weight DESC, id
SELECT * FROM ad_slot ORDER BY slot_key, weight DESC, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_slot (slot_key, title, content, link_url, theme, weight, status, start_at, end_at) VALUES (#{slotKey}, #{title}, #{content}, #{linkUrl}, #{theme}, #{weight}, #{status}, #{startAt}, #{endAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ad_slot SET slot_key = #{slotKey}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, link_url = #{linkUrl}, theme = #{theme}, weight = #{weight}, status = #{status}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
